photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 15:17:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 1615 s; on-screen clock 04/27/13 15:17:50, wanted 15:17:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT13-116 MSG 15:17-15:20' on 2013-04-26 (`as run matrix!B110`), read as 2013-04-26 15:17. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-26 plus one day, 15:17: it was found 1565 s into this video, and in no other video. The fan setting on screen (82) is one the matrix's fan cell gives ('82', `as run matrix!J110`).
